blocks.title: Civil support for seismic upgrades.
blocks.body:
Seismic upgrades often mean excavating beside foundations of buildings that must stay in use. Our crews dig carefully along foundations, handle services and backfill, and plan the site so the facility keeps operating.

For the City of Vancouver we have supported the seismic upgrades of Fire Hall No. 12 in Kitsilano and the Manitoba Yard fuel station. For School District 38 we did the site works for the seismic upgrade at Howard DeBeck Secondary in Richmond, including temporary portables so classes could continue.

items.title: Excavation along foundations
items.text: Careful excavation beside existing foundations and footings.

items.title: Service trenches
items.text: Trenching and reconnecting services around the building.

items.title: Civil works
items.text: Backfill, compaction, drainage and surface restoration.

items.title: Temporary facilities
items.text: Site preparation and servicing for temporary portables.

items.title: Working around operations
items.text: Planning access and staging so fire halls, schools and yards keep running.

items.title: Safety
items.text: COR certified safety program for work beside occupied buildings.

items.q: Do you work on seismic upgrade projects?
items.a: Yes. We provided excavation and civil works for seismic upgrades at Fire Hall No. 12 and the Manitoba Yard fuel station for the City of Vancouver, and at Howard DeBeck Secondary for School District 38.

items.q: Can you work while the building stays open?
items.a: Yes. At Howard DeBeck Secondary we built the site for temporary portables so classes could continue.

blocks.title: Planning a seismic upgrade?
